title: Edition Consolidation, GitHub Collaboration, Peer Review & Schema Validation
query: How do GitHub collaborative workflows (forks, pull requests, issue tracking) combined with XML schema validation and structured peer review improve data integrity and student learning in digital scholarly editing projects?
